page.notes: The "s" long s has been normalised to s throughout. The line "fatum vniuscuiusq; & con-stare" has no printed hyphen after "con", so it is written whole as "constare". Some letters in the lower entries are small and may be misread. The index is printed in two columns of entries before the last line; this part shows the lower portion of the page only. The words "of seum" and "sinum" are doubtful because of the long-s forms and the wear of the type.
